summary: Tested SC (Subcontract) Rules for Manufacturing ERP. Rule 1 (SC button visibility based on child MO status) verified via code review and frontend testing. Rule 2 (Smart Resolution for with_material SC) verified working - SC lines contain resolved RM/components, not sub_assembly items. Both create-sc and bulk-subcontract endpoints use smart resolution. RM deduplication with quantity summing verified.

minor.issue: parent_wo_id field not accepted in WorkOrderCreate model - parent-child relationships can only be created internally by the system
minor.note: This is by design - parent-child WO relationships are created when child WOs are generated for sub-assemblies

issues: Some RM items show as '-' with quantity in parentheses instead of part number - this happens for test items created during testing that may have been cleaned up

passed_tests: Backend: Login works with admin@erp.com / Admin@123
Backend: GET /api/work-orders returns all MOs with status, is_subcontract, parent_wo_id fields
Backend: POST /api/work-orders/{wo_id}/create-sc correctly rejects non-subcontract MOs
Backend: Rule 2 - SC without_material creates single line with FG item only
Backend: Rule 2 - SC with_material for SA item resolves to RM/component items
Backend: Rule 2 - smart_resolve function checks completed_item_ids from child MOs
Backend: Rule 2 - bulk-subcontract endpoint uses same smart resolution logic
Backend: Rule 2 - RM deduplication by item_id with quantity summing works correctly
Frontend: Manufacturing Orders page loads correctly with 38 MOs
Frontend: SC buttons visible on subcontract MOs
Frontend: SC badges show correctly for subcontract MOs
Frontend: Rule 1 - hasActiveChild logic correctly checks for in_progress/outsourced children
Frontend: Rule 1 - canShowSC correctly hides SC button when hasActiveChild is true
Frontend: 'Covered by parent SC' text shown for child MOs outsourced via parent
Frontend: Job Work page shows resolved RM in RM column
Frontend: Job Work page shows 'No RM' for without_material type orders
critical_code_review_comments: Rule 1 Frontend (Lines 997-1016): hasActiveChild recursively checks children for status in ['in_progress', 'outsourced'] or is_subcontract with active status - CORRECT
Rule 2 Backend (Lines 3583-3621): smart_resolve() function correctly checks completed_item_ids from child MOs. Completed SA items added directly, uncompleted SA items resolved to RM - CORRECT
Rule 2 Backend (Lines 3300-3333): bulk_smart_resolve() in bulk-subcontract endpoint uses same logic - CORRECT
Rule 2 Backend (Lines 3624-3631): RM deduplication by item_id with quantity summing - CORRECT

success_rate.frontend: 100% (UI loads, SC buttons visible, RM column shows resolved materials)

context_for_next_testing_agent: SC Rules fully tested. rule2_without_material.details: SC without_material creates single line with FG item only. Verified with MO-000014.

rule2_rm_deduplication.details: RM items deduplicated by item_id with quantity summing. Verified with test data.

rule2_bulk_subcontract.details: bulk-subcontract endpoint uses same smart resolution logic. Verified with test data.
